items.title: NEA seeks extra P7 billion to eliminate non-technical system losses
items.description: NEA says eliminating non-technical system losses will require a phased transition, with cooperatives needing billions in loans for metering and other upgrades before they can absorb the costs

items.title: Palace leaves impeachment vote threshold to Senate
items.description: The Palace backed the former Supreme Court justices' view that the decision on the voting threshold for convicting Vice President Sara Duterte lies solely with Senate impeachment court.

items.title: FACT CHECK: No lockdown in Malacañang after court ordered VP Sara’s arrest
items.description: No credible reports confirm that barricades and barbed wire were installed around Malacañang due to the issuance of Duterte's arrest warrant, contrary to the claim

items.title: BuCor denies drone escape of South Korean drug lord
items.description: The Bureau of Corrections has ruled out the possibility of inmates escaping from penal facilities using unmanned aerial vehicles.

items.title: Ridon issued show cause for impeachment comments
items.description: The impeachment court has yet to determine whether the House prosecutor violated Rule 18.

items.title: After Senate passes bill, will 2026 barangay, SK polls be postponed?
items.description: The measure fixes the term of all elected barangay and SK officials to five years and moves the village and youth polls to the second Monday of November starting in 2028

items.title: Marcoleta says no furlough bid for impeachment threshold vote
items.description: The detained senator insists the impeachment threshold is already in the Constitution.

items.title: Rappler Live Jam: Healy After Dark
items.description: Catch the 'Isip' hitmakers perform on Rappler Live Jam for the first time!

items.title: FACT CHECK: INC rally misrepresented as protest against VP Sara arrest warrant
items.description: The video shows a commotion between police and members of the Iglesia ni Cristo during a June 2026 protest in support of Senator Rodante Marcoleta

items.title: DOE scraps coal bid, plans rebid in weeks as Semirara contract nears expiry
items.description: ‘We’ll rebid in a few weeks. New rules, new bidding,’ Energy Secretary Sharon Garin tells Rappler as Semirara’s contract nears its July 2027 expiry

items.title: House summons Meta’s Zuckerberg over child safety, defers action on 2027 DICT budget
items.description: The DICT says Meta Platforms 'continues to fall short of its responsibility and commitment to youth safety,' and authorities will take steps to remedy that in the Philippines

items.title: Romualdez aide in plunder case left PH before travel ban — BI
items.description: The personal assistant of former House speaker Martin Romualdez, who is charged with him in a P7.44-billion plunder case, left the Philippines before the Sandiganbayan banned them from exiting the country, according to the Bureau of Immigration.

items.title: The Villafuertes of CamSur: A tale of political survival and reinvention
items.description: The Villafuertes have figured in well-publicized teleserye-like dramas: from family feuds, celebrity marriages, social media tit for tat, to political wranglings, reinvention, and shifting political alliances

items.title: World View with Marites Vitug: Inside the fight against POGOs
items.description: Rappler editor-at-large Marites Vitug speaks to former PAOCC officials Winnie Quidato and Winston Casio about their book, The Rogue Compound: POGOs, Human Trafficking, and the Fight to Reclaim the Philippines

items.title: Can impeachment court decisions be appealed to SC?
items.description: Former associate justice Azcuna says the Supreme Court may reverse the Senate's ruling on the conviction threshold, but retired chief justice Panganiban says the High Court should not intervene

items.title: DOF seeks to triple sugary drinks tax
items.description: The Department of Finance said higher taxes on sugary drinks is not only a revenue collection policy, but also a health measure.

items.title: Meta child safety concerns behind House 'call' for Mark Zuckerberg to hearing
items.description: The House of Representatives has called Meta chief executive Mark Zuckerberg to a hearing and put the Department of Information and Communications Technology's proposed 2027 budget on hold until concerns over child safety on Meta's platforms are resolved.

items.title: 4 listed passengers didn't board MV June Aster, says PCG
items.description: Four passengers listed in the manifest of MV June Aster did not board the vessel before it left Baseco Port in Manila on September 8, the Philippine Coast Guard said.

items.title: SWS: More Pinoys fall victim to cybercrimes
items.description: ore Filipinos have fallen victim to cybercrimes in the second quarter of the year, according to a new survey by Social Weather Stations.

items.title: DepEd taps 170  leaders to boost SHS graduates’ employability
items.description: The Department of Education  has tapped the assistance of more than 170 leaders across government, industry and strategic economic sectors in implementing the work immersion program under the Strengthened Senior High School curriculum to improve the employability of graduates.
